original_title: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B
overview: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B explores the music scene from the Brazilian state of Ceará between 1969 and 1979 - a period marked by the military coup, the implementation of the AI-5 decree, and intense socio-political ferment. The focus is on the "Pessoal do Ceará" movement, which brought artists such as Fagner, Ednardo, and Belchior to prominence. Taking the 1973 álbum as a starting point, the work examines its common association with these three singers - even though, in reality, only Ednardo (alongside Rodger and Teti) is featured on it.
title: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B

data.overview: Pessoal do Ceará – Lado A Lado B aborda a música cearense entre 1969 e 1979, período do golpe militar, AI-5 e efervescência político-social. Eixo: o movimento Pessoal do Ceará, projetando Fagner, Ednardo e Belchior. Partindo do álbum de 1973, questiona sua associação aos três cantores, embora Ednardo seja o único, com Rodger e Teti.

Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B explores the music scene from the Brazilian state of Ceará between 1969 and 1979 - a period marked by the military coup, the implementation of the AI-5 decree, and intense socio-political ferment. The focus is on the "Pessoal do Ceará" movement, which brought artists such as Fagner, Ednardo, and Belchior to prominence. Taking the 1973 álbum as a starting point, the work examines its common association with these three singers - even though, in reality, only Ednardo (alongside Rodger and Teti) is featured on it.
